chunks: Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih said to al-Sadiq عليه السلام:
"Can a man perform hajj on behalf of a Nasibi?" He said: "No."
I said: "What if it was my father?" He said: "If it was your father, then perform hajj on his behalf."

key_terms.النَّاصِبِ: a person who harbors enmity toward the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.يَحُجُّ: performs hajj on behalf of someone

ai.seo_question: Can someone perform hajj on behalf of a Nasibi, especially if he is his father?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing hajj on behalf of another person. It prohibits doing so for a Nasibi in general, while making an exception when that person is one's father, showing the special consideration of kinship.
